ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VALUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_value IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER; 

 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100);
 v_count_DCL NUMBER;
BEGIN 
V_COUNT := 0;
--=======================================================================
IF :END_DT IS NULL AND :START_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 :END_DT := :START_DT;
ELSIF :START_DT IS NULL AND :END_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 :START_DT := :END_DT;
ELSIF :START_DT IS NOT NULL AND :END_DT IS NOT NULL AND :START_DT > :END_DT THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب ان يكون تاريخ النهاية اكبر من تاريخ البداية','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
ELSIF :END_DT IS NULL AND :START_DT IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب ادخال تاريخ البداية او النهاية','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE; 
END IF;
------------------

BEGIN
select 1 INTO v_count
from SD_PORTS P , stats_dcltns_CD s, stats_items_CD si , COLL_ORDERS_CD co , COLL_ORDER_DTLS_CD cod 
where s.PORT_CD = si.PORT_CD and s.stats_ISN = si.stats_ISN 
and s.STATS_DT BETWEEN :START_DT AND :END_DT
--AND to_char(s.STATS_DT,'yyyymmmi') >='14340301'and to_char(s.STATS_DT,'yyyymmmi') <='14340428'-- TO_DATE('01/03/1434 00:01:00', 'dd/mm/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE('01/04/1434 00:28:00', 'dd/mm/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
and si.TARIFF_CODE in ('02071100','02071200','02071300','020711000000','020712000000','020713000000')
AND P.PORT_CD = S.PORT_CD
AND co.PORT_CD = S.PORT_CD
and co.STATS_ISN = s.STATS_ISN 
AND co.PORT_CD = COD.PORT_CD
and co.COLL_ORDR_NBR = cod.COLL_ORDR_NBR 
 and co.COLL_ORDR_DT = cod.COLL_ORDR_DT 
 and co.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = cod.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY 
 and cod.ACCT_SEQ =2 
 and rownum =1
;
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 v_count :=0;
END;

if v_count = 0 then 
BEGIN
select 1 INTO v_count_DCL
from SD_PORTS P , DECLARATIONS_CD s, DCLTN_items_CD si , COLL_ORDERS_CD co , COLL_ORDER_DTLS_CD cod 
where s.PORT_CD = si.PORT_CD and s.DCLTN_ISN = si.DCLTN_ISN 
and s.DCLTN_DT BETWEEN :START_DT AND :END_DT
--AND s.DCLTN_DT between TO_DATE('01/03/1434 00:01:00', 'dd/mm/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE('01/04/1434 00:28:00', 'dd/mm/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
and si.FINAL_TARIFF_CD in ('02071100','02071200','02071300','020711000000','020712000000','020713000000')
AND P.PORT_CD = S.PORT_CD
AND co.PORT_CD = S.PORT_CD
and co.DCLTN_ISN = s.DCLTN_ISN 
AND co.PORT_CD = COD.PORT_CD
and co.COLL_ORDR_NBR = cod.COLL_ORDR_NBR 
 and co.COLL_ORDR_DT = cod.COLL_ORDR_DT 
 and co.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = cod.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY 
 and cod.ACCT_SEQ =2 
 and rownum =1
;

EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 v_count_DCL :=0;
END;
end if;
 --=====================================================================================
 IF v_count > 0 OR v_count_DCL > 0 then 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'no'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'yes'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب','ERROR'); 
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_CHECK_VALUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE print_check_value IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5); 

 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100);
BEGIN 
V_COUNT := 0;
--=======================================================================
IF :END_DT IS NULL AND :START_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 :END_DT := :START_DT;
ELSIF :START_DT IS NULL AND :END_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 :START_DT := :END_DT;
ELSIF :START_DT IS NOT NULL AND :END_DT IS NOT NULL AND :START_DT > :END_DT THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب ان يكون تاريخ النهاية اكبر من تاريخ البداية','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
ELSIF :END_DT IS NULL AND :START_DT IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب ادخال تاريخ البداية او النهاية','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE; 
END IF;
------------------
SELECT SUM(CNT) INTO v_count 
FROM
(
select COUNT(*) CNT
from DECLARATIONS s, DCLTN_items si , COLL_ORDERS co , COLL_ORDER_DTLS cod 
where s.PORT_CD = si.PORT_CD and s.DCLTN_ISN = si.DCLTN_ISN 
and s.DCLTN_DT BETWEEN :START_DT AND :END_DT
and si.FINAL_TARIFF_CD in ('02071100','02071200','02071300','020711000000','020712000000','020713000000')
and co.DCLTN_ISN = s.DCLTN_ISN and
 co.COLL_ORDR_NBR = cod.COLL_ORDR_NBR 
 and co.COLL_ORDR_DT = cod.COLL_ORDR_DT 
 and co.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = cod.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY 
 and cod.ACCT_SEQ =2 
UNION
select COUNT(*) CNT
from stats_dcltns s, stats_items si , COLL_ORDERS co , COLL_ORDER_DTLS cod 
where s.PORT_CD = si.PORT_CD and s.stats_ISN = si.stats_ISN 
and s.STATS_DT BETWEEN :START_DT AND :END_DT
and si.TARIFF_CODE in ('02071100','02071200','02071300','020711000000','020712000000','020713000000')
and co.STATS_ISN = s.STATS_ISN and
 co.COLL_ORDR_NBR = cod.COLL_ORDR_NBR 
 and co.COLL_ORDR_DT = cod.COLL_ORDR_DT 
 and co.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = cod.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY 
 and cod.ACCT_SEQ =2 
)
;

------------------

 --=====================================================================================
 IF v_count > 0 then 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE := 'STATS365';
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'no'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'yes'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب','ERROR'); 
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

END;
